item.title: Announcing ANN in Japan 2027 Tour
item.content:encoded: Anime News Network is going to Japan again, and we want to bring you with us. Join us as we weave through the greater Tokyo/Kanto area, visiting many of the same spots anime producers and manga editors have visited to create the setting for their projects. Not enough? We'll be going to Kyoto, Kobe, Osaka and more!

item.title: Exploring Studio ENGI, the Anime Studio Behind Medalist
item.content:encoded: During the PacSet “ANN in Japan 2025” tour, anime fans from around the globe were granted the exceedingly rare privilege to see how and where the sausage gets made.
